_about: English patterns of the rule-book findings built in rulebook.py, used to show them in the report language. Placeholders: p, n, st, d = planet; names, hidden = list of planets; h = house number; houses = list of house numbers; start, end = dates; areas, quick, extra_jup, extra_node, exc, why, fields, dig = phrases from 'phrases'. Findings made of data-file lines (K12, 2L, 12L) are translated line by line from 'lines' in each language file.

patterns.F001: Rahu's sign lord and star lord are at odds (6/8 or 2/12): Rahu dasa needs care - gains come with setbacks.
patterns.F002: Ketu's deciding planets are 6/8 or 2/12 from each other: Ketu dasa is harder than the house alone suggests.
patterns.F003: Matters of house {h} ({areas}) tend to come late at first and are delivered later.
patterns.F004: Job and business are balanced; the running dasa decides which way it goes.
patterns.F005: Plans to buy property may end in selling; keep property papers and loans in order in this dasa.
patterns.F007: Distance between spouses (living apart, separate finances) is possible in this dasa; give the relationship extra care then. Not a reason on its own to reject a match.
patterns.F008: These dasas bring 12th-house expenses and losses; plan spending.
patterns.F009: Generally good; may bring job changes and moves for work.
patterns.F010: Most dharma lords are weak: settling takes persistent effort; gains come later.
patterns.F011: A mix of supportive and weak dasas between 15 and 50.
patterns.F012: Rahu dasa gives the results of its sign lord and star lord, which support each other: a productive Rahu dasa whatever house Rahu occupies.
patterns.F013: Ketu dasa can bring sudden, lasting gains: its deciding planets are strong and support each other.
patterns.F014: Ketu dasa works well: its sign lord and star lord support each other.
patterns.F015: Dasas of retrograde planets follow one another ({names}): a long stretch where results come in reverse order - patience pays, gains come late.
patterns.F016: The 5th lord is retrograde: a self-chosen (love) marriage is more likely than an arranged one.
patterns.F017: Retrograde Mercury linked to a node: research ability - a PhD or a lasting invention is possible.
patterns.F018: Mercury alone and retrograde: bold to the point of acting against all advice - decisions should be checked with someone trusted.
patterns.F019: Employment suits better than running a business.
patterns.F020: A job plus a side business suits this chart.
patterns.F021: Business suits this chart: when a period hurts the 6th house, the native tends to leave the job for an own venture.
patterns.F022: Own business is not advised; the native does best in employment.
patterns.F023: In employment the native rises to top positions{quick}; an own business struggles.
patterns.F024: Big career yoga; own business suits.
patterns.F025: Strong in competition; an own business can do very well (pioneer, few rivals).
patterns.F026: Work abroad brings hardship in these periods; staying in the home country is better.
patterns.F027: Goes abroad for work in these periods and lives comfortably there.
patterns.F028: Goes abroad for work in these periods.
patterns.F029: Four or more planets in the 10th: a detached, renunciate streak may show; career needs a closer look.
patterns.F030: Three planets in the 10th with its own-sign lord: wealth through career.
patterns.F031: A high-status government position is indicated.
patterns.F032: Major wealth yoga - delivered in the dasas of these two planets.
patterns.F034: Wealth lords support each other: a dhana yoga chart.
patterns.F035: In the 12th lord's dasa debts can build up and commitments get hard; keep savings, especially for retirement, well guarded.
patterns.F036: Spending in this dasa turns into assets - house, land, vehicle, a business, deposits; investment rather than salary builds the wealth.
patterns.F037: Money keeps coming in through later life; no need to hoard anxiously for retirement.
patterns.F038: In these dasas income from investing (funds, shares, deposits, property) beats running a business.
patterns.F040: Financial success, through its sign lord's strength.
patterns.F041: Success comes late, after many challenges.
patterns.F044: A prosperous dasa: household goods, vehicles, property.
patterns.F045: Financial strain in this dasa; avoid promises that are hard to keep.
patterns.F046: Good earnings in the 5th lord's dasa.
patterns.F047: Borrowing is likely in the 5th lord's dasa; keep debt in check.
patterns.F048: Property, a good house and vehicles.
patterns.F049: An own home tends to come late.
patterns.F050: Own property may come late; registering property in the spouse's name (if the spouse's 4th lord is stronger) is a common remedy.
patterns.F051: Property brings gains; good for buying property.
patterns.F052: Buys land and a house; property grows in this dasa.
patterns.F055: Property purchases can turn into a burden; check finances first.
patterns.F056: The 7th lord is strong for a dual lagna, which is often labelled a marriage dosha; it acts only in the 7th lord's dasa. If that dasa is over or comes late, ignore it when matching.
patterns.F057: The usual strain on married life from this placement is neutralised.
patterns.F058: Family life needs care in the 2nd lord's dasa; harmless if that dasa is over or comes late.
patterns.F059: The usual worry about Venus in the 7th does not apply: Venus in own sign gives a supportive spouse.
patterns.F060: Marriage is assured, even in Saturn dasa.
patterns.F061: Rahu in the 8th is not a marriage dosha here: its deciding planets are well placed; marriage can happen even in Rahu dasa.
patterns.F062: The 2nd lord gives a family, then turbulence within it in its dasa; patience and space help.
patterns.F063: Family members may live apart for a while in this dasa (often for work); it lasts only for the period.
patterns.F064: Sun with Mars is often called a marital dosha; with one of them strong, it does not apply.
patterns.F065: A research path later in life; finish the main degree first.
patterns.F066: Good for higher education (an engineering stream suits).
patterns.F067: A long stay abroad is indicated (permanent residence abroad is possible).
patterns.F068: A change of job, business or residence is close to certain in these dasas (short stints abroad in the bhuktis).
patterns.F069: Each of these planets' dasas becomes productive (foreign links, investments).
patterns.F070: A major yoga: career and financial rise, own business success{extra_node}.
patterns.F071: Own business succeeds; large earnings and investment gains.
patterns.F072: Enjoys time alone; meditation and quiet suit.
patterns.F073: Spiritual depth, pilgrimages and quiet charity; intuition through dreams.
patterns.F074: Sound sleep and peace of mind, whatever the bank balance.
patterns.F075: A yoga: lends money to others rather than borrowing.
patterns.F076: Losses or domestic strain in its dasa.
patterns.F077: Adhi yoga: prosperity, comforts, success over opponents.
patterns.F078: Not a hidden or weak placement: a strong yoga.
patterns.F079: Debilitated Saturn without rescue: Saturn dasa needs care; harmless if it falls in childhood or very late.
patterns.F080: Saturn has positional strength: its dasa is a yoga period (career and assets).
patterns.F081: Saturn is linked to Jupiter or a node: its dasa turns favourable.
patterns.F083: Sun with Moon (new-Moon birth): strong will; the house they occupy gets a mixed start that improves.
patterns.F084: All three dharma lords hold up: life tends to flow and efforts pay.
patterns.F085: Two of the three dharma lords hold up: steady progress with one weak area.
patterns.F086: A long run of weak dasas between 15 and 50: progress is slow despite the yogas in the chart; expect results later and plan for them.
patterns.F087: Every dasa between 15 and 50 is supportive: a good working life.
patterns.F088: Rahu dasa is good overall, with one area of strain tied to the house of {hidden}.
patterns.F089: Big career yoga through employment, possibly top management.
patterns.F090: Employment in a top-priority role (not business).
patterns.F091: Family life is fine: the node link rescues the retrograde 2nd lord.
patterns.F092: Retrograde Saturn in the 12th for this lagna strains family, finances or health in its dasa.
patterns.F093: Hardship in its dasa (finances when young, family strain in a child).
patterns.F094: Turns into a yoga (e.g. in the 4th: property and vehicles).
patterns.F095: Debilitated Saturn is rescued (retrograde, cancellation, Jupiter or a node): Saturn dasa turns favourable.
patterns.F096: Saturn is dignified but retrograde with no rescue: its dasa gives less than expected.
patterns.F097: Moon with {n}: worry and restlessness in their periods; routine and rest help.
patterns.F098: {p} is retrograde but Jupiter aspects or joins it: the reversal is neutralised; judge {p} normally.
patterns.F099: Strong self-respect and sense of status{extra_jup}; may leave a job over lack of recognition. Flexibility at work serves better than pride in this period.
patterns.F100: In {p} dasa the job is hard to settle or below expectation (may need to relocate or take a smaller role; an own business is not advised then). The second half eases.
patterns.F101: No marital dosha from this placement: its dispositor is strong.
patterns.F102: {d} dasa runs in the study years: suited fields include {fields}. Combine with marks, interest and affordability.
patterns.F103: {p} sits in a hidden house but its dasa still succeeds (the house lord is strong or Jupiter helps).
patterns.F104: {p} dasa may be difficult (in house {h} without support).
patterns.F105: {p} dasa has friction from its star lord {st}: expected gains may not fully come.
patterns.F106: Moon with {n} in the Moon's own or exaltation sign: no eclipse dosha; the node boosts the Moon.
patterns.F107: Moon with {n} is neutralised by Jupiter or a strong sign lord.
patterns.F108: Retrograde {p} is linked to Rahu/Ketu: its period turns into a yoga.
patterns.F109: Studies may slow down in {p} bhukti ({start} to {end}); they pick up again when it ends.
patterns.F110: A career shift is indicated but may not happen ({exc}).
patterns.F111: When these periods begin, a job or business change is close to certain - and it moves the native up (better role, income, or an own venture). Some turbulence until the planet's own bhukti ends.
patterns.F112: {d} dasa, {p} bhukti ({start} to {end}): pressure or a push out of the current job; business owners should avoid over-investing (stock, machinery). Most people end up better placed after it.
patterns.F113: {n} and {p} share the same nakshatra pada: instead of a boost this pairing tends to fail in their periods.
patterns.F114: {n} amplifies {p} ({why}): a yoga, not a dosha; the periods of both are strengthened.
patterns.F115: {n} with a debilitated {p}: the weakness is magnified in their periods; avoid big risks then.
patterns.F116: {p} is debilitated and retrograde: it gives the results of an exalted planet in its period.
patterns.F117: {p} is {dig} but retrograde: it loses its positional strength; its period gives less than its dignity promises.
patterns.F118: {p} is a benefic for this lagna but retrograde: expect delays or reversals in the matters of houses {houses} during its period.
patterns.F119: {p} is not a benefic for this lagna and is retrograde: its harm is reduced and it can even help in its period.
patterns.NK01: {p} in Mrigashira: a seeker who keeps chasing the next goal; enjoys travel, speed and fragrances.
patterns.NK02A: Moon in the first pada of Mrigashira: the search centres on creativity, romance and studies.
patterns.NK02B: Moon in the second pada of Mrigashira: the search turns analytical - checking, reviewing and measuring.
patterns.NK02C: Moon in the third pada of Mrigashira: the search is for beauty, comfort and money.
patterns.NK02D: Moon in the fourth pada of Mrigashira: the search turns inward - occult subjects, spirituality and hidden knowledge.
patterns.NK03: {p} in Punarvasu: events repeat for {who} - returning to a place, a job or a person after a gap.
patterns.NK04: Mercury in Punarvasu: a name change, or a name with repeated letters, is likely for {who}.
patterns.NK05: The 7th lord {p} is in Vishakha: married life can see phases of distance; conscious effort keeps it together.
patterns.NK06: The 4th lord {p} is in Vishakha: likely to live away from the family home at some stage.
patterns.NK07: {p} in Anuradha: rises from modest beginnings and gathers loyal supporters; a devotional nature.
patterns.NK08: Rahu in Rohini: devotion to Krishna; pilgrimages such as Khatu Shyam may appeal.
patterns.NK09: Ketu in Rohini: a liking for the flute or other wind instruments for {who}.
patterns.NK10: {p} in Dhanishtha in the 7th house: the spouse is likely to be musical, with a feel for rhythm.
patterns.NK11: The 7th lord {p} is in a nakshatra linked with late marriage: marriage may come later, or one may choose to stay single.
patterns.NK12: {p}, a lord of wealth, is in Dhanishtha: unearned money such as inheritance or family property is likely.
patterns.NK13: {p} in the Gemini pada of Ashwini: a possibility of twins in the family.
patterns.NK14: {p} in Ashwini: quick and active; loves vehicles and speed; caring towards animals.
patterns.NK15: {p} in Ashlesha: a strategic mind suited to chess, mathematics or research; attachments run deep for {who}.
patterns.NK16: {p} in Krittika: a talent for cooking, or for work that involves cutting and editing such as film.
patterns.NK17: The 7th lord {p} is in Purva Ashadha: marriage tends to come early.
patterns.NK18: {p} in Shravana: learns best by listening; drawn to the sky and the stars.
patterns.NK19: {p} in Hasta: a distinctive smile and a good sense of humour; likes rings, watches and hand adornments.
patterns.NK20: {p} in Magha: a pull towards leadership and public standing; fond of grand furniture and ancestral traditions.
patterns.NK21: Saturn in Ardra: work that lifts up the neglected, people or stray animals; struggles come first and recognition late.
patterns.NK22: {p} in Ardra or Moola: likely to keep dogs or care for strays.
patterns.NK23: {p} in a Phalguni nakshatra: left-handedness may show up for {who}.
patterns.NK24: {p} in Uttara Ashadha: does not accept defeat; keeps returning until the goal is won.
patterns.NK25: {p} in Pushya: steady growth and nourishment for {who}.
patterns.NK26: Wealth star (Sampat tara) is {nk}: keeping its symbol, {sym}, nearby as a picture or wallpaper is a simple remedy that costs nothing.

phrases.extra_node: - even bigger with the Rahu/Ketu link
phrases.fields.Jupiter: HR, administration, finance, marketing, banking, insurance, logistics
phrases.fields.Mercury: IT (with Rahu: AI; with Moon: creative AI; with Saturn: accounts; with Sun: science and technology)
phrases.fields.Rahu: electrical, electronics, computer science, mechatronics, foreign trade
